subject: tech
title: Apps and Programs
about: Apps and programs: software is instructions that do a job, icons are the little pictures you tap, the home screen, opening and closing, picking the right app for the task (draw, read, snap a photo, play music, find the way, add numbers), apps are made by people, some cost money so ask first, and an update makes an app newer. NC K2-CS-03 (operate software to do tasks), K2-IC-02 (choose software that fits the need) and K2-CS-01 (choose the right device). Read it together with his home screen open so he can point at each icon.
tip: Open his home screen and let him say what each icon's app is for before he taps it.

cards.note: An app is a set of instructions for the computer. Each app does one job, like drawing or reading.

cards.q: Apps and programs have a grown-up name. What is it?
cards.note: Software is the instructions. Hardware is the parts you can touch, like the screen and the keys.

cards.q: The little pictures on the home screen that you tap to open apps are called what?
cards.note: Each icon is a tiny picture for one app. Tap it once and the app opens.

cards.q: Where do you see all the icons lined up?
cards.note: The home screen is where the tablet starts. Press the home button or swipe up from the bottom to get back to it.

cards.q: You want to start an app. What do you do to its icon?
cards.note: One gentle tap on the icon opens the app. No need to press hard.

cards.q: You are finished with an app. What do you do to leave it?
cards.note: Go back to the home screen to leave the app. Closing apps you are done with keeps the tablet tidy.

cards.q: You want to draw a picture. Which app do you open?
cards.note: Pick the app made for the job. A drawing app has brushes and colors.

cards.q: You want to read a story on the tablet. Which app fits?
cards.note: A reading app shows books. Some can read the story aloud with you.

cards.q: You want to take a photo of your dog. What app do you need?
cards.note: The camera app turns on the camera. Tap the big round button to snap the photo.

cards.q: You want to hear a song. Which app plays it?
cards.note: A music app plays songs. Use headphones if someone nearby is reading.

cards.q: You are in the car and need to find the way to Grandma's house. Which app helps?
cards.note: A maps app shows where you are and the road to take, like a paper map that talks.

cards.q: You need to add 5 plus 3. What is the best app to pick?
cards.note: Different jobs need different apps. Think: what is this job? Then pick the app made for it.
People called programmers write the instructions for every app. Someone made your favorite game.

cards.q: An app says it costs money to get. What do you do first?
cards.note: Some apps cost real money. A grown-up decides and types the password, not you.

cards.q: The tablet says an app has an update. What does an update do?
cards.note: An update is the people who made the app sending fixes and new things. A grown-up taps update.

cards.q: What is another word for an app?
cards.note: Program and app mean the same thing: instructions that tell the computer what to do.

cards.q: Your favorite game on the tablet is a kind of what?
cards.note: Games are apps too. Someone wrote the instructions for every jump and every level.

cards.q: A game pops up and asks you to buy more coins. What do you do?
cards.note: Pop-ups that want money are a grown-up's job. Stop, and show the screen to your grown-up.
